reviews.title: It used to be so much better
reviews.text: It used to give you our by our data, I could have about six locations, and it would tell the forecast for many more days. Now they want an outrageous amount of money per week or per month to get what used to be free.

reviews.title: Force Subscriptions?
reviews.text: This has been my go to weather app for years, but now it is trying to force me into a subscription. No, there is no way to exit or get past that screen. Very disappointing.

reviews.title: Used to be great.  Now limited by sales ads
reviews.text: I used to rely on this app.  Had the widgets on my devices, so very useful!  Now I can’t see anything on the app except the ad for going “pro”.

reviews.title: Was really good, now just greedy
reviews.text: The developer is getting inflated and greedy. The app use to be relatively affordable and useful. Now the price regularly goes up by a few dollars. Currently it’s almost as much as Netflix use to be, sitting at 12.99 PER MONTH

reviews.title: Too much money!
reviews.text: Rate increase is ridiculous but of course it is tough to cancel.

reviews.title: Rip off @ $520 per year!
reviews.text: Why all the 5 star reviews, seems suspicious to me.  The app is fairly useless unless you upgrade to the paid $10 per week version. The free one has half the screen covered with upgrade messages and then the full screen paid upgrade message comes up whenever you click anything else. With all those great reviews it sure looks like someone is gaming the system. I have a hard time believing that people are really that happy to pay $10 per week, $520 per year for a weather app, that’s half the price of your phone!!!

reviews.title: Why change?
reviews.text: Uninstalled- everything is locked behind a paywall now, greedy smh

reviews.title: App pricing
reviews.text: I was thinking about getting this app again, but the fact that they are not upfront about there available plans, with pricing, before you download the app and have to go into settings to figure out if you can afford the app, is deceiving and sneaky. Shame on you! You are supposed to be helpful! People’s lives depend upon the forecasted weather being available, and I’m not saying you don’t deserve to be paid, I’m saying that it’s wrong not to be upfront about your available pricing and what each level includes before someone down loads the app. To me, you are relying on people forgetting to cancel before the free trial is over and that is blatant by the way you don’t place a purchase at the end of the free trial period. You take away the free days left. Most respectable apps allow the free trial period to complete before starting the paid subscription. Shame on you. And no upfront pricing before we have to download the app! Double shame on you!!

reviews.title: Warning : Ads (cookies or porn your choice) i thought this was the weather?
reviews.text:
Prior to now the biggest problem was the ads and the bait and switch to get you to purchase the premium  version was a bit annoying. My reservations  to purchase mainly the forcasts of local weather was not accurate 50% of the time anyway. And the cookie settings added on. But  still, the free version was better than a lot of the others. 
Not sure why they let this happen, but its even worse now. I know the ads make money but my privacy rights shouldn’t come at a price - the ads have gott n offensive and really - not being overly sensitive but if i open the app and anyone around sees that i would be horrified. And they let you elect to sell your soul and all else  by choosing to allow cookies for personal targeted ads which seems like the only ways to get that to stop. But it certainly says a lot about the devloper if they dont care who they sell ad space to. 
Think twice about what you are getting into, or at least a heads up if you dont want that to happen at work and your boss walks by and wonders what your doing when you look at the weather and ads splash across the bottom with naked adult pics. wth ????? Delete app and hope to sabotage your life

reviews.title: Used to be good but now almost everything is behind a paywall
reviews.text: When I downloaded this app a few years ago, it was really accurate and useful for helping me predict the weather. Now it's a subscription service and almost everything is behind a pay wall. All you get for free now is if it's raining or not rn. Which you can just look out of a window. If you go on the internet even bing will provide you with the info they want to charge you for now and for that I'll be deleting the app.
